mission.goal: Implement the highest-value remaining recorder evidence access through canonical CLI/MCP, with meaningful direct-main GitHub commits and no PRs.

published_checkpoints.change: Current Query+ReadMedia source permit, pre-original complete-receipt deletion admission, final deployment context checks and complete native projection; nine context contracts and 95 passing actual-source component contracts.

Canonical AOP-005 recorder UTC CLI/MCP selector, owner-only source verification grant, complete bounded response and capabilities, precision/permission/process contracts, operator guide and existing replay qualification lane.

findings: The existing canonical recordings query could select catalog/node-clock metadata but could not access original packet-linked recorder UTC assertions.
Recorder UTC verification reads private original datagrams internally, so existing metadata-only query permission cannot silently authorize it.
Complete receipt references must be checked against current deployment deletions before original root/index/payload reads, including originals outside the requested interval.
The native query/report/index and every matched, unknown or source-only proof retain their existing identity under the same exact native request.
An empty receipt remains explicit and states that no original source bytes were read; it cannot establish physical absence.
CLI and MCP share one parser/renderer; the replay response accurately exposes both effective Query and ReadMedia capabilities while existing metadata query envelopes remain unchanged.

authority.user: Implement and commit directly to main with GitHub; no PRs.

authority.new_runtime_scope: Exact source-read verification only, bound to request/principal/source anchor/generation/read limits, with current cancellation/deadline checks.
authority.transport: CLI explicit yes; MCP launcher-only grant; clients cannot grant source authority or override roots/principal.
authority.release: Local repository qualification and retained DSR receipts remain required; hosted checks are supplementary.
